game.title: 魔法の数字
game.description:
Magic Numbers (魔法の数字) is a small Japanese number-swiping game set in a cave covered in darkness. The developer presents it as an intentionally niche experience for people who understand its mysterious numbers.

Its premise is simple: respond to the displayed numbers with a swipe in either direction. The creator also suggests sharing the experience with a friend or an audience.

game.tips:
Read the on-screen prompts before choosing a direction.

game.title: Erwin Smith Run
game.description:
This unofficial Attack on Titan fan game celebrates Erwin Smith’s birthday with a horseback charge through ruins and open fields. Slash approaching Titans and return incoming boulders while surviving on three health points.

The Beast Titan appears after roughly two and a half minutes. Defeat his reaching arms or reflect his projectiles until Levi arrives. Chinese-language instructions explain the two-action combat system.
game.how_to_play: Jump over low hazards, slash Titans, and parry boulders. A warning mark on the right announces incoming rocks. If defeated during the boss encounter, restart directly from that fight.

Jump – Space, Up, or W; left-side screen tap; controller A
Slash/parry – J, X, K, or Right; right-side screen tap; controller X
Pause – Esc or P; top-right pause icon; controller Back
Mobile – landscape orientation; portrait pauses play
game.tips:
Slash at close range for double-score perfect kills.
Avoid swinging early: a missed slash briefly prevents another attack.

game.title: Morningbelle
game.description:
Your new graveyard job in Wisperell becomes complicated when cleaning an abandoned grave introduces you to Noel. The mysterious ghost needs help passing on before Halloween, but his missing memories and your uneasy coworker suggest a deeper mystery.

Morningbelle is an English visual novel combining ghost romance with point-and-click investigation. Name a gender-neutral protagonist whose pronouns are unspecified, then uncover the town’s secrets.

Content warnings: death, blood, murder, gaslighting, manipulation, physical restraint, nonsexual touch, obsessive and possessive behavior, and screen shaking.

game.controls: Point and click to explore. See the original itch.io page and in-game menus for additional control notes.
game.tips:
Pay attention to the contrast between Noel’s account and your coworker’s concerns.
The developer provides an endings guide in the itch.io devlogs.

game.title: Gyra - Top Fighting
game.description:
Gyra - Top Fighting puts you in direct control of a customizable spinning top. Combine a tip, body, blade, and spirit to change its behavior, then steer it around a 3D arena. Your spirit supplies a special move that becomes available once charged.

Matches reward positioning as well as construction: dashes can evade or strengthen a hit, shields help you hold ground, and victory comes from a ring-out or exhausting the opponent's stamina. Tournament victories earn caps for shopping between rounds. Browser and mobile editions have some feature limitations; the developer recommends desktop for the complete experience.
game.how_to_play: Choose four components, enter a match, and control your top's movement. Combine dashes, shielding, and a charged spirit attack. In tournaments, spend winnings between rounds to adapt your build.
game.controls: Remappable keyboard and controller controls; touchscreen supported. Check the in-game bindings for movement, dash, shield, and special attack.
game.tips:
Use dashes to reposition as well as attack.
Review your components before the next tournament opponent.

game.title: Physician Simulator (Demo)
game.description:
Physician Simulator places a newly qualified doctor in Clinic No. 67 for mandatory service. Patients arrive with genuine symptoms, questionable requests, and occasionally forged referrals. Read their records, examine them, and decide whether to prescribe, refer, issue a certificate, or refuse.

Every examination takes time. You have an hour of appointments, with 12 minutes allocated per patient; delays can send booked patients away with complaints. This demo contains five working days and up to 40 patients, with progress resumable from the last day. The longer full game remains in development. Browser play works best on a computer; use landscape orientation on phones.
game.how_to_play: Check allergies, conditions, and medications before choosing examinations. Inspect referral details, select an appropriate decision, then sign and stamp the paperwork while watching the clock.
game.controls: Follow the in-game interface and original itch.io page for control instructions.
game.tips:
Read the whole chart before prescribing.
Inspect document dates, stamps, and license formats.

game.title: I Can Smell You from Here
game.description:
An incel meets his first dating-app match for his first date. One lie creates pressure for another, and maintaining a consistent story demands increasingly ridiculous explanations. I Can Smell You from Here builds its horror around that spiral and the excuses justifying it.

Your decisions lead toward five endings. Each run produces a psychological evaluation showing how close you came to your date's heart. The game is available in English and Russian. Content warning: body horror, violence, cannibalism, references to murder, strong language, and sexual themes.
game.how_to_play: Follow the date, choose responses, and see where your version of events leads. Review the end-of-run evaluation, then try different decisions to explore other outcomes.
game.controls:
Advance dialogue – Enter, Space, or left click
Navigate choices – Arrow keys or mouse wheel
Confirm choice – Hold Enter, Space, or left click
Fast-forward – Hold one of those inputs for 3 seconds
Review dialogue – Mouse wheel
Options – Tab
game.tips:
Review recent dialogue to track your story.
Hold the confirmation input to commit a choice.
game.features:
Five endings
Consequential choices
Run-specific psychological evaluation
English and Russian
